inlines.v: ANAL'CIME, n. Cubic zeolite, found in aggregated or cubic crystals.This mineral is generally crystallized, but is also found amorphous, and in reniform, mammillary, laminated or radiated masses. By friction, it acquires a weak electricity; hence its name, Gr. weak.
